page.overview:
Who is W.O.R.M.S.?

Weapons Ordnance Rugged Machine Specialists (W.O.R.M.S.) are the artillery specialists of the Cobra ground forces. Trained to man any position on a Maggot, be it driver, gunner, loader or even diesel mechanic. A four man team can be completely self efficient out in the battle field but even a two man team can successfully do the job.

W.O.R.M.S.es were deployed on Cobra operations including:
